title: Levels and experience
summary: XP for each level, and how to level up
lede: Your level follows your experience points (XP) and nothing else. Levels are handed out when the Wanderer visits you after a long rest outdoors.

items.label: Rest needed
items.note: At most one full rest counts per 14 hours.

blocks.text: The level formula has no cap of its own, but every XP gain we have checked stops at 9,999. That makes level 8 the highest you can reach.

The killing blow earns the creature's **maximum** HP ÷ 4, rounded down, plus 1. All of it goes to the character who lands the blow; nothing is shared with the party. The [Bestiary](/original/bestiary/) shows the figure for every creature.
How you actually gain a level

XP alone does nothing until the Wanderer finds you. After a qualifying rest outdoors he may visit, and only then are levels recalculated. See [Levelling and the Wanderer](/original/how/levelling/) for every step and the exact odds.
